questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:2 (ESV): "to whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign."

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:5 (ESV): "I appointed you a prophet to the nations."

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:6 (ESV): "Then I said, 'Ah, Lord God! Behold, I do not know how to speak, for I am only a youth.'"

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:8 (ESV): "Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you, declares the Lord."

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:9 (ESV): "Then the Lord put out his hand and touched my mouth."

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:10 (ESV): "to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant."

questions.question: What was the first thing the Lord asked Jeremiah if he saw in a vision?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:11 (ESV): "And I said, 'I see an almond branch.'"

questions.question: What did the Lord declare regarding the almond branch?
options: "I am watching over my word to perform it."

questions.question: What was the second vision Jeremiah saw?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:13 (ESV): "And I said, 'I see a boiling pot, facing away from the north.'"

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:14 (ESV): "Then the Lord said to me, 'Out of the north disaster shall be let loose upon all the inhabitants of the land.'"
